scope.included: C3 checked Vorbis setup/output/Ogg wrappers; current CYD Vorbis registration and decoder retry/EOF ownership; actual installed codec2.6.2 ESP32/C3 archive selected members and public interfaces; read-only nm/objdump.
scope.excluded: Deferred AAC private owner-view is wholly excluded. No such source/object is selected or investigated, no transitive AAC verifier executes. Generic shared public container interfaces are inspected only for Ogg/Vorbis ownership. No builds, source/test/docs/Git edits or board operations.
scope.mutations: Only new ignored audit outputs in this folder. No tracked source/test/docs/Git/SDK mutations, builds, decoder execution or device operations.

conclusions: Proceed with a separately qualified Xtensa-specific port: six concrete target binary defects/call-order problems justify the checked setup, checked Ogg open/error propagation, PCM preflight and pending-packet preservation.

No conflicting offset was found in the independently examined target consumers/cleanup paths; this is partial corroboration, not proof that RV32 private ABI is portable in full. All sizes, alignment, signed fields and consumers must be qualified with actual Xtensa builds and decodes before production enablement.

Most existing CYD registration rollback, PCM owner release, resize retry, EOS drain loop and failed-handle close already exist; reuse them and test the actual service. Do not copy task core affinity, stack sizes, pool/TLS/IRAM tuning or donor performance numbers.
No standard conformance pass, target PCM/OOM result, heap reduction or speedup is claimed by this audit. Stage14 remains open.

confirmed_binary_flow_findings.title: Failed Vorbis open reads and frees an already freed wrapper
confirmed_binary_flow_findings.scenario: After wrapper/info allocation succeeds, an invalid or allocation-failed setup header takes the cleanup path. The wrapper pointer remains in a3 after media_lib_free; execution falls through to read a3+0 and later calls media_lib_free on a3 again.
confirmed_binary_flow_findings.observed: esp_vorbis_dec_open +0xf7 clears info, +0xff frees info, +0x109 frees wrapper; +0x10c loads wrapper->dsp from the freed wrapper; +0x12f frees the wrapper again. Symbolic allocator relocations and instructions establish the defect without donor layout assumptions.

confirmed_binary_flow_findings.title: PCM capacity is checked after Vorbis synthesis mutates history
confirmed_binary_flow_findings.scenario: A valid audio packet is offered with a too-small PCM buffer and the caller resizes then retries the same packet, as current CYD audio_service does.
confirmed_binary_flow_findings.observed: esp_vorbis_dec_decode calls vorbis_dsp_synthesis at +0xab, then computes output bytes from dsp out_begin/out_end/channels and checks output capacity at +0xe9. The insufficient-buffer branch sets needed_size and returns -8. The history mutation follows from the called target synthesis implementation; exact audible corruption is not measured here.

confirmed_binary_flow_findings.title: A second undersized retry drops the retained Ogg packet
confirmed_binary_flow_findings.scenario: The Ogg simple decoder already holds pending_data/pending_bytes after BUFF_NOT_ENOUGH. A retry still returns BUFF_NOT_ENOUGH.
confirmed_binary_flow_findings.observed: esp_audio_simple_dec_process +0xc0 reads pending_bytes, +0xd9 calls decode. Every nonzero result branches +0xde to +0x100; +0x102 stores zero pending_bytes and +0x104 reports the prior pending_consumed. The initial parser-fed -8 branch at +0x21c instead retains these fields. No error-specific exception exists on the retry path.

required_gates_all_unrun_here.checks: Compile whole repair TUs against SDK6.0.2 real headers/config. Assert all bridge fields, ELF machine94, two CPU target with assertions, all nine wrappers and real targets linked once, operation table selects repaired open/decode; no direct original route or accidental C3 object. Exact negative guards for wrong archive/target/missing wrapper. Host private-layout tests are supplementary.

Freeze original ESP32 raw-packet ample-buffer output with packet boundaries and trim metadata. Compare repaired raw output exact byte/sample/hash equality; independent pinned libvorbis/ffmpeg golden for container/granule and documented fixed-point tolerance. C3 fixture/golden may seed corpus but its PCM counts, hashes and error bounds are not ESP32 results.

Actual Ogg and raw at tiny, needed_size-1, repeated tiny, exact needed_size and ample capacity; alternating short/long blocks, first priming frame,64modes/two-byte header, last page multiple packets, final-byte split, empty separate EOF, repeated EOF, reset/reopen, empty/truncated streams. Named checks for no consumed or PCM/history change on rejected retry, no missing/duplicate PCM and final trim.

Discover successful target allocation sequence first, then fail every actual alloc/realloc on open/setup/DSP/Ogg header/cache/packet and PCM resize. Guard regions and owner ledger detect UAF/double free/leaks; each failure returns a defined error and no PCM, NULL publication when open fails, repeated owner release safe, then valid play works. Include persistent registration failures and rollback. Fault instrumentation must not replace native_health hook or confuse allocator fault injection with physical heap measurement.

required_gates_all_unrun_here.checks: Real FreeRTOS tasks on both cores with barriers: independent Ogg handles, nested process scopes, out-of-scope and zero-size realloc, non-Ogg passthrough, reset only after per-handle process quiescence. Actual decoder_task generation changes, Stop→Play, output resize-failure, network EOF/no-EOS/error, stale data and queue leases. This does not authorize concurrent reset/close on one handle, excluded by public API.

Distinguish legal audio packet truncation from malformed setup. Ogg lacing255/0, cross-page packets, CRC/version/sequence errors, BOS/EOS, serial changes/chained logical streams and granule trim against authoritative expected behavior. This bounded audit and one golden are not conformance certification.

Undo each fix separately: reintroduce early free, omit one NULL check, wrong bridge offset, synthesize before capacity check, clear pending on second -8, swallow allocation failure, use process-global instead of task-local scope, drop final real byte. Each expected named semantic check must fail; unexpected panic/timeouts are not successful controls except an explicitly retained historical crash reproduction.

authorities.title: Xiph.Org Vorbis I specification
authorities.summary: Legal block sizes include8192. Sparse unused entries have no Huffman nodes. First audio block primes overlap; later output depends on both block sizes. Audio packet truncation has defined semantics. Ogg Vorbis may cross pages; final granule can trim PCM. Hardware exceptions require explicit support in the specification.
